STOS Picture Packer: RECOIL has no support (recoil2png rejects it). Header, compression and per-variant pixel order per Deark mbk.c. Output matches Deark stos pixel for pixel (medium resolution lines doubled); only difference is palette scaling: Deark reads all 16 palette words, finds STE bits and scales 4-bit, while only the 4 words the picture uses are checked here (ST 3-bit scaling), as for the other ST decoders. The colour mapping to Deark is one-to-one
